# Source

Live2D Cubism SDK for Web 5-r.5, downloaded from the official SDK site with the repository owner's license consent on 2026-11-11. Core includes only files permitted by its redistribution list and the original license. Framework source and GLSL shaders retain the Live2D Open Software License. No model assets are included here.

Official archive: https://cubism.live2d.com/sdk-web/bin/CubismSdkForWeb-5-r.5.zip
